# Goofy ball library

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_goofy_docs.py from src/gate/goofy_params.inc + goofy_player_params.inc. Do not edit by hand. -->

Goofy exposes **156 ball params**: every one of the game's 124 `BallPhysics` exports, 27 ball-contact
`PlayerFeel` exports (hit range, block / ball hitboxes, player gravity / jump) and 5 Goofy-only flight params
(air drag, speed cap / floor, curve scale) that the game itself does not have. The player library
(movement, jump, animation, body scale, ...) is in docs/GOOFY-PLAYER.md; the API for other mods is
docs/GOOFY-API.md (Goofy library) and docs/CORE-API.md (CORE facades + capabilities).

## What you can do with the ball
| area | how |
|---|---|
| physics params, gravity, bounce, size | params below (`ball.*`), any layer (config, court pack, mod) |
| spin and curve | `ball.*` spin / curve / float params, `flight.curve_scale`; live `goofy_ball_set_curve` (offline) |
| speed caps | `ball.*` speed limits, `flight.max_speed` / `flight.min_speed`, `flight.air_drag` |
| trail and visuals | `ball.trail_*`, `ball.outline_*`, `ball.contest_*` (visuals section) |
| state reads | `goofy_balls` / `goofy_ball_state`: position, velocity, speed, curve, strike sequence, frozen, serve held, hitter, radius, scale, airborne |
| live writes | `goofy_ball_set_velocity`, `goofy_ball_set_curve`, `goofy_ball_impulse` (capability `goofy.ball_live`, offline only) |
| event hooks | bus events `goofy_ball_event` (bounced, struck, net_hit, wall_hit, antenna_hit; with ball index + args), `goofy_params_changed`, `goofy_ball_mode_changed`, `goofy_physics_allowed_changed`, `goofy_sync_changed` |

## How it reaches the game (runtime only, no pck / exe edits)
Every access goes through CORE (`jvm_goofy_io()`, capabilities `ball.physics`, `player.feel`,
`player.tuning`, `ball.flight`, ...), so strict mode, refusal logging and the gate rules apply to Goofy too.
* `ball.*` -> the game's shared `res://game/ball/ball_physics.tres` (`static var PHYS = preload(...)`,
  ball.gd:10). The Ball has no physics-engine body; every collision is analytic from `PHYS.*`
  (ball.gd 2181-2416), so editing the resource changes the real hitboxes. The game's own launch
  solvers read the same values, so aim stays right.
* `player.*` (ball-contact set) -> the game's shared `res://game/player/player_feel.tres` (`static var FEEL`,
  player.gd:18). Hit range = `FEEL.reach` + bonuses (player.gd:6741-6752). Player gravity is
  `FEEL.gravity`, not the engine / world gravity (no PhysicsServer edits).
* `flight.*` -> Goofy writes `Ball.vel` / `Ball.curve` each physics frame (in flight only; skipped
  while the game holds, freezes or hit-stops the ball, or it rolls). The game has no air drag or
  global speed cap (`step_flight`, ball.gd:2239), so these are pure additions. The game's landing
  marker does not know about drag or caps, so with `flight.*` set the ring is approximate.
* apply **live** = takes effect on the next frame / next touch. `ball.net_half_width` /
  `ball.antenna_half_width` are copied into each Ball when it is created (ball.gd:21-22), so Goofy
  writes them into live balls too.
* `ball.radius` changes the visual too: the game sizes the model from `PHYS.radius` when it dresses
  a ball (ball.gd:845); Goofy scales only what is missing (never double-scaled).

## Where the values are live
* **Offline** (Free Play, practice, offline solo, the menu): your own layers (config, court, mods).
* **LAN / private / friends-only lobbies:** in the lobby you play your own layers. From **match start**
  (or lobby practice) to **match end**, every **gameplay** param (column `sync` = host: hitboxes,
  gravity, drag, bounce, spin, speed caps, movement, jump, ...) and the time scale are the **host's**
  effective values on every modded player; each client simulates them locally, so its prediction
  matches. **Visual-only** params (column `sync` = visual (own): the visuals sections and every
  colour) stay each player's own. At match end, or when the host leaves, your own values come back
  (docs/GOOFY-SYNC.md). An unmodded player in the lobby is unaffected (the game itself is never sent
  anything).
* **Public / quick match / server browser:** never. Everything is stock (CORE gate rule: local-only).
* Originals are captured before the first edit and restored exactly when a param goes back to stock,
  when the gate closes or when the libraries stop being allowed.

## User config (mods/goofy/*.json)
Existing keys keep their meaning: `big_ball` (x ball.radius, 1.0 = off), `ball_physics.gravity_scale`
(x ball.gravity), `ball_physics.bounce_scale` (x ball.floor_bounce) and bare BallPhysics names inside
`ball_physics` (absolute). `ball_params` is keyed by the ids below. Value = number (absolute),
`{"mul": f}` (x stock) or `[r,g,b,a]` for colours. If both say the same param, `ball_params` wins.
```json
{
  "big_ball": 1.0,
  "ball_physics": { "gravity_scale": 1.0, "bounce_scale": 1.0 },
  "ball_params": {
    "ball.floor_bounce": 0.8,
    "flight.air_drag": 0.25,
    "flight.max_speed": 25,
    "player.reach": { "mul": 1.5 },
    "ball.outline_home": [0.2, 0.6, 1.0, 1.0]
  }
}
```
The Mods-menu editor validates `ball_params` (unknown id or out-of-range value -> refused with the
reason). At runtime out-of-range values are clamped to the table's min / max.

## Params
Defaults are the game's (recovered scripts, build 26827091); at runtime the stock value is read from
the live resource, so a game update that retunes a value is picked up. Ranges are ours (generous;
mostly 0 .. 5x stock). Units are inferred from the game's names / use (`x` = factor).

## Host sync classification
148 of the 156 ball params are **gameplay** (they alter the ball or a player) and follow the host
during a synced match; 8 are **visual-only** (trail, outline, rings, indicator colours) and stay each player's own:

`ball.trail_min_speed`, `ball.outline_home`, `ball.outline_away`, `ball.outline_contested`, `ball.contest_band`, `ball.contest_min_vz`, `ball.trail_fast`, `ball.trail_fast_speed`.

Rule: a param is visual-only when it is a colour or sits in a `visuals` section; everything else is gameplay
(when in doubt, gameplay: e.g. the animation section also holds `player.dump_tilt`, which decides dump shots).

## Decisions
* **Everything that alters the ball or a player follows the host** in LAN / private / friends matches, unless
  it is visual-only (owner decision). This includes the time scale: the host's Goofy `time_scale` (1.0 when it has
  none) is sent with the gameplay params at match start, applied by each client and re-asserted after the game's
  own short hit-stop slow-mo ends, so ball prediction runs at the same rate everywhere. The client's own time
  scale comes back at match end or when the host leaves.
* There is no separate space-platform gravity or underwater drag in the game (build 26827091) or in Goofy: the
  space stage only changes visuals and footstep sound. Ball / player gravity (`ball.gravity`, `player.gravity`)
  and drag (`flight.air_drag`, `flight.vertical_drag_scale`, `ball.roll_drag`) are ordinary gameplay params and
  follow the host.
* Generic `overrides` (arbitrary node properties) are never synced: only the typed, range-checked params are.
* Public lobbies stay local-only for gameplay (stock physics, nothing sent).

## Found but not exposable (and why)
* **GDScript `const`s in ball.gd / player.gd** (float-serve shape, stop-set, `NET_CLEAR_MIN_DIST`, reach
  limits, ...) are compiled into the script bytecode; changing them needs a script edit (pck), which
  is off-limits.
* **Per-ball rule state** (`spike_lock`, `float_seed`, court bounds, walls, dome) is set by the game every
  rally / stage; overriding it would fight the game each frame. Velocity and curve are reachable
  through `flight.*` and the live writes.
* **Rule toggles** (GDScript static vars such as `Ball.stop_sets`) are game-rule switches, not ball properties.
* **Visual-only model / material bits** (shaders, trail particles, ring meshes) are cosmetic and owned by the
  texture / ball-skin packs.

## Ball override (stage picker): NORMAL / FIXED
* In the game's own stage picker card, one row between the tile grid and "done": label "ball" + buttons
  **normal** / **fixed** built from the game's own `UiStyle` (no new art). Shown only while the highlighted
  tile is a loader map (a custom stage pack); hidden on the game's own maps.
* Saved in `mods/goofy/state/ball_override.json` (`{"version":1,"mode":"normal"|"fixed"}`).
* **FIXED** on a loader map = every BALL-library param is the game's value: your own Goofy config, the map's
  `goofy` block and other mods' layers are ignored for the ball. The player library, rules (max hits, no
  double hit), time_scale and generic overrides are not affected.
* **Stock maps:** the toggle is never consulted; your own config and other mods' layers apply as usual.
* In a synced match the client uses the host's gameplay values, so the host's FIXED / NORMAL choice is what everyone gets.
